incident: accidental overwrite of the lake manifest for nse/bhav/dt=2022-08-08 version 1
cause: a diagnostic command `xxd <v0001.bin> <v0001.manifest.json>` was run with an unquoted two-file glob; xxd's second positional argument is its OUTPUT file, so the manifest was replaced by a hex dump of the raw file
restored_from: the manifest text printed by `cat` earlier in the same session (before the overwrite), staged outside the lake and validated: valid JSON, checksum field equals the sha256 of the raw file, size field equals the raw file length
restoration_method: install to v0001.manifest.json.restore in the same directory, then atomic rename, approved by the owner
release_impact: benchmark-release-1.0 untouched (its inputs were hashed in the database and audit outputs, not this manifest)
